comparison.objective: Experimentally choose a liner that prevents a glass sliding on a 20° rack, then deploy it and place the glass.
comparison.physical_skill: Material testing, flexible-liner handling, glass placement, and release versus rigid tool insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, setscrew locking, and impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Glass remains on a selected gripping liner on the 20° rack; the record omits slip distance, dwell time, and damage thresholds. Candidate requires two quantified safe stops plus post-lock drift control.
comparison.reason: Both use empirical trials to choose a setting/material, but friction-material selection and deformable placement are meaningfully different from tuning and securing a mechanical damper.
